signature: SUBROUTINE ZLACPY( UPLO, M, N, A, LDA, B, LDB )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies the part of the matrix A to be copied to B.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part Otherwise:  All of the matrix A

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The m by n matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, only the upper trapezium is accessed; if `UPLO = 'L'`, only the lower trapezium is accessed.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On exit, $B = A$ in the locations specified by `UPLO`.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.
